Modular Construction

Explore related projects

Thinking differently about how we build.

Modular only works when it is designed in from the start. BOW's approach is to run the modular strategy in parallel with the planning process, so the module grid, the transport envelope and the compliance pathway are settled before the permit drawings are. We deliver volumetric modular buildings with our steel and modular partner, with design freeze hold points, a clear split between modular and in-situ work, and a programme that is usually months shorter than the conventional alternative. Current work includes residential towers in Brisbane and a build-to-rent development in South Melbourne.

How we can help

  • Volumetric modular strategy alongside planning
  • Design for manufacture and assembly (DfMA)
  • Design-freeze hold points
  • Modular and in-situ scope coordination
  • Transport, logistics and compliance planning
